The first matching rule wins. A rule whose VERS is malformed, or whose comparison throws, is skipped and does not hide a later rule. Each finding names the file and line, and carries its rule's source, replacement, deadline, migration guidance, and verification commands. A rule that lists usage matchers also lists
usages. The bundled Play Billing rules do not list matchers, so those findings point at the declaration only.
